description: This file contains functions and type definitions for formatting and displaying skill-related information in a CLI, including listing skills, showing skill details, and checking skill statuses, with support for JSON output and terminal table rendering.

methods.name: appendClawHubHint
methods.description: Adds a tip message about ClawHub-backed skills unless output is JSON.

methods.name: formatSkillStatus
methods.description: Returns a string representing the status of a skill with themed icons.

methods.name: normalizeSkillEmoji
methods.description: Normalizes emoji strings, replacing variation selectors.

methods.name: sanitizeJsonString
methods.description: Removes ANSI escape sequences and control characters from a string for JSON safety.

methods.name: sanitizeJsonValue
methods.description: Recursively sanitizes JSON values, strings, arrays, and objects.

methods.name: formatSkillName
methods.description: Formats a skill's name with emoji and themed styling.

methods.name: formatSkillMissingSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string of missing components for a skill.

methods.name: formatSkillsList
methods.description: Formats a list of skills into a table or JSON, with filtering options.

methods.name: formatSkillInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about a specific skill, with JSON or styled output.

methods.name: formatSkillsCheck
methods.description: Generates a summary report of skill statuses, with JSON or styled output.
